title: Smoked Old Fashioned

items: 2 oz TX whiskey or whiskey/bourbon of choice

steps: Smoke the inside and outside of a rocks glass.
Add simple syrup, whiskey and both bitters to a stirring glass with ice. Stir for 5 seconds and strain over ice in the smoked glass.
Express the orange peel over the drink, rub it around the rim and garnish. Add a black cherry if desired.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
